paragraphs.text: The university library provides physical books, electronic books, academic journals, and research databases to students and faculty.
The main library is open from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM on weekdays. Weekend opening hours are shorter than weekday hours.
Students may borrow up to five books at a time. The standard borrowing period for undergraduate students is fourteen days.
The library provides dedicated group-study rooms. Students can reserve these rooms through the university library portal.
Research support is available through librarian consultations. Librarians can help students identify databases, develop search strategies, and locate academic sources.
